text:
Hannah L.: Quick sync: APAC lab flagged an odd interaction when MI300 and H200 share the same rack PDU under sustained seq2seq workloads. Could affect our marketplace sloting and any APAC joint announce.
Ravi S.: Oof. What failure mode are we seeing?
Hannah L.: Thermal trips on the midplane sensors after ~45min of 32k-token runs; voltage sag reported by the PDU logs.
Jorge M. (hw-partner): Confirmed from SI field tests last month. Our recommendation was to avoid mixing MI300 with H200 in the same PDU zone unless the rack has an upgraded PSU or explicit thermal zoning.
Claire P.: We need to surface this to Marketplace and Partnerships: possible options are SKU gating for APAC regions, "reduced_density" flags, or delaying public GA messaging for affected SKUs.
Mark T.: Ops note: we measured tail-latency spikes when the PDU started power-capping; requests saw token slowdown but not outright failures. Important for SLAs.
infra-bot: ATTACHMENT: pdu-log-apac-2026-03.txt
Hannah L.: Proposed immediate steps:
1) Add a compatibility flag for "pdu_thermal_risk" per region/SKU in the compatibility API.
2) Update SI onboarding checklist to include "separate PDU zones" and "rack PSU rating >= X kW".
3) Plan a 10-day canary in one APAC region with reduced_density and telemetry hooks for midplane temps and PDU voltage.
Jorge M. (hw-partner): I'll deliver a short rack layout doc and an SI checklist snippet by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi S.: I'll draft the Marketplace copy for SKU remarks: short line: "pdu_thermal_risk — may reduce density in APAC labs; see compatibility docs."
Claire P.: Partnerships wants embargo windows for any joint press that mentions APAC capacity. Hold public GA until canary passes.
Mark T.: Can we auto-route requests to compatible variants when a region flag trips? Example: route H200 traffic to H100-equivalent model in another region or to quantized variant.
infra-bot: Feature note: auto-route hooks ready; needs product flagging and policy rules. Endpoint: https://internal-api.company/compatibility/pdu_thermal_risk.json
Hannah L.: Action owners:
- @Jorge M.: rack layouts + SI checklist (ETA: tomorrow EOD)
- @infra-bot: publish pdu_thermal_risk endpoint and telemetry (ETA: today afternoon)
- @Ravi S.: marketplace copy + SKU flag mapping (ETA: Thu)
- @Mark T.: define SLA fallback behavior and console rollback copy (ETA: Fri)
- @Claire P.: draft embargo windows and partner comms plan (ETA: after canary)
Jorge M. (hw-partner): Will also include a small table for recommended slotting in the deliverable: ```
slotting_apac_v1:
MI300: recommend isolated PDU, 1 per rack
H200: recommend isolated PDU or max1 per zone
H100: mixed ok with Gaudi if thermal zoning applied
Mixed(MI300+H200): not recommended without upgraded PSU
```
Ravi S.: Nice. We'll map to flags: ["isolated_pdu","reduced_density","embargo_hold"].
Hannah L.: Agree on a conservative approach for APAC launch messaging. Once canary telemetry shows stable temps and no voltage sag for 10 days, partnerships can clear a staged GA.
Claire P.: Will prep partner-facing comms template that explicitly calls out regions and SKU caveats.
Mark T.: I'll prepare a short blurb for the rollout dialog: "If PDU thermal risk is detected, traffic will be auto-routed to compatible variants to preserve latency SLAs."
infra-bot: PDU sweep scheduled; will post results and flag URL when done.
Hannah L.: Thanks all — invite for canary kickoff meeting incoming. Closing thread for now unless blockers appear. :smiley:
